exposure: Indications for cesarean section (previous cesarean section, fetal distress)
outcome: Distribution of cesarean sections across Robson's Ten Groups Classification System (TGCS)
cohort: The study included 165 women who underwent cesarean section at a tertiary care hospital in India.
finding: Robson's Group-5 and Group-2 were the most contributing categories for cesarean sections, with previous cesarean section and fetal distress identified as the most common indications.
